הלכודים שהו בקומה התחתונה והקומות העליונות קרסו עליהם. השיפוע של המבנה מקשה על נסיונות החילוץ

היא יצאה מהמכונית עם הישמע האזעקה ונשכבה על הקרקע
מירב: "הייתי בממ"ד, היה בום. הבנתי שזה קרוב. יצאתי מהממ"ד וכל הבית זכוכיות"
שכן: "אנחנו ממש מטווחים"
משפחת דגן: "פוסט טראומה ופציעה מוסרית הן פציעות שירות לכל דבר"
אישה כבת 90 נפצעה באורח קשה, שעה שנחבלה בדרכה למרחב המוגן ואיבדה את הכרתה בבניין בתל אביב
חילצו שני לכודים שנמצאו תחת ההריסות ללא רוח חיים
אלפים הגיעו בכל זאת לים המלח בפסח, ובתי המלון באזור רשמו תפוסה של 80%
האתרים סגורים לפי הנחיות פיקוד העורף, שמורות הטבע אסורות - אבל אלפים הגיעו בכל זאת
אישה כבת 90 נחבלה בדרכה למרחב המוגן בתל אביב ונפצעה באורח קשה
שני לכודים שנמצאו תחת ההריסות ללא רוח חיים
פעילות "ארלי על גלגלים" ביקרה ב-14 יישובים בצפון, עובדת עם הורים וילדים יחד במקלטים בזמן אזעקה
המפגשים כוללים משחקי תנועה וצחוק להפגת מתח, סיפור ושיח משותף, ותחנות פעילות סביב נושאים כמו כוחות וחוזקות, תקווה ואופטימיות
4 פצועים במצב קל עם סימני שאיפת עשן בחיפה: גבר ואישה בשנות ה-40 ו-2 ילדות בנות 5
אישה בת 34 נפצעה באורח קשה בפתח תקווה לאחר שנפגעה מרסיס
נהגת כבת 34 ששמעה את האזעקות בעיר, נשמעה להנחיות פיקוד העורף, ירדה מהרכב ונשכבה בצד הדרך
יונה יהב: "זה מחזיר אותנו להנחיות פיקוד העורף שצריך למלא אותן בקפידה ובלי להתחכם, כי אין דרך אחרת"
יהב: "לכמחצית מהבניינים בעיר יש פתרונות מיגון, אך לדבריו יש צורך בהרחבת המענה"
יהב: "לאחר המלחמה הקודמת נרשמו כ-2,000 איש להליך מקוצר לבניית ממ"ד, אך בפועל רק חמישה מימשו אותו"
ראש עיריית בת-ים צביקה ברוט הודיע כי העיר תפתח את גני הילדים וחלק מהכיתות היסודי והתיכונים לאחר שהעירייה סיימה היערכות מקיפה
ברוט: "ל-50 אחוז מהילדים בגוש דן אין מיקלוט תקני בבית, אבל אם הם הולכים לגני הילדים ל-100 אחוז מהם יהיה מיקלוט תקני בזמן אזעקה"
כ-15 זירות באזור המרכז בשל הירי מאיראן - בתל אביב, רמת גן, פתח תקווה, בבני ברק ובקריית אונו
אישה בת 34 שנפצעה באורח קשה, עם פציעה בחזה משברי יירוט
שבעה בני אדם נפגעו באירועים, בהם אישה כבת 32 שנפצעה באורח קשה, גבר כבן 30 שנפצע בינוני, פצוע נוסף באורח קל וארבעה נפגעי חרדה
פרמדיק מד"א נועם דהן: "כשהגענו למקום ראינו רכב עם חלונות מנופצים ובתוכו הייתה אישה בת 34 כשהיא בהכרה וסובלת מפציעות קשות בגופה משברי יירוט"
שיגור טיל המצרר מאיראן לעבר מרכז הארץ הוביל לפיזור פגיעות בעשרות מוקדים בגוש דן - עם שבעה נפגעים
הפצועה הקשה בזירה בפ"ת יצאה מהרכב עם הישמע האזעקה ונשכבה על הקרקע בהתאם להנחיות
אלון פרסמן: "שמענו פיצוץ אדיר, חשבנו שאולי הייתה פגיעה ישירה... כששמעתי את הבום חשבתי שאני עומד לעוף, הרגשתי ממש הדף"
אלון פרסמן: "חשוב להיכנס למרחב המוגן... רצתי מהר למרחב המוגן"
ראש עיריית בת-ים, צביקה ברוט, הודיע כי העיר תפתח אחרי חופשת הפסח את גני הילדים ואת חלק מכיתות היסודי והתיכונים
שר החינוך יואב קיש הודיע כי מערכת החינוך תמשיך לפעול במתכונת שפעלה בה ערב חג הפסח, בהתאם למפת הצבעים ולהנחיות הביטחוניות

Store manager V.: 'I'm a sole provider, I have a wife and daughter, so of course I work.' Describes hearing alerts and explosions with composure: 'You hear a whistle, explosions, then silence. You have to be careful not to exit immediately when silence is heard.'
Store manager V.: 'You just have to follow the instructions. Alert, go to a protected space, and exit only when permitted.'
Store in Petah Tikva hit three times in same location; manager continues operating; customers continue entering and exiting in normal flow; increased foot traffic reported since strikes.

Education Minister Yoav Kisch announced education system will return to activity on Thursday (9 April) in the same format as before Passover break. No changes to learning framework on Thursday and Friday.
Woman aged 80 fell at shelter entrance in Tel Aviv, lost consciousness, transported to Ichilov Hospital in critical condition with head injury.

In Jerusalem area, alerts sounded without advance warning, causing panic. Home Front Command stated: 'There are situations where an alert will be received without advance warning based on operational conditions.'
Woman aged 34 injured severely with chest wound from interception debris in Petah Tikva; transported to Beilinson Hospital in serious condition.
Two trapped individuals extracted without vital signs from building ruins in Haifa after direct Iranian missile strike. Building sustained direct hit to lower floor causing collapse of three floors.
Woman aged 90 found unconscious near stairwell, suffered severe head injury while attempting to reach protected space. Transported to Ichilov Hospital in critical, unstable condition.
MDA paramedic Ido Adelheit: 'We provided life-saving medical treatment including intubation and transported her to hospital in unstable condition.'
Woman aged 34 injured severely from interception debris in Petah Tikva; multiple vehicles caught fire; emergency response teams conducted search for additional casualties.

MDA paramedic Noam Dahan: 'We found a 34-year-old woman conscious but suffering severe injuries from interception debris. We provided life-saving medical treatment and transported her to hospital in serious condition.'

Three Haredi teenagers became trapped in a ravine at Dragot cliffs during Passover holiday hike in wartime. Helicopter rescue team extracted them using hovering technique under challenging terrain conditions.

Iranian ballistic missile broke apart in air, causing interception failure in Haifa. Direct hit on multi-story residential building; warhead did not detonate. Building collapse caused casualties; two trapped individuals extracted without vital signs.

Rambam Hospital reported five patients admitted from morning missile barrage: four family members (parents and two children) and one additional patient. All classified as light condition and discharged.

Education Ministry announced upcoming weekend will operate in remote learning format. Ministry examining models for 30-50% physical student presence with rotating shifts between in-school and remote learning starting next week.

Communications Ministry arranged agreement with cellular companies (Cellcom, Partner, Pelephone, Hot Mobile, Rami Levi) to waive overage charges for remote learning data and call usage, eliminating connectivity fees.
Elderly woman aged 90 injured severely after falling while entering shelter in Tel Aviv, lost consciousness. Transported to Ichilov Hospital with head injury in unstable condition.

MDA paramedic Ido Adelheit: 'We found a woman in her 90s unconscious near stairwell with severe head injury after falling while entering protected space. We provided life-saving medical treatment including intubation and transported her to hospital in unstable condition.'
Haifa fire station commander Deputy Chief Kobi Mizrachi: 'This is the most difficult scene in the district so far in this war, both in terms of destruction scale, complexity, and casualties.'
Child aged 6 from Lod died at Shamir-Assaf Harofeh Hospital after choking on swing rope in home yard. Incident occurred during play; child lost consciousness.

Captain (res.) Assaf Dagan recognized as IDF casualty after prolonged struggle. Suffered moral injury and post-traumatic stress from intensive military service over two decades, leading to his death during reserve duty.

Woman aged 34 struck by interception debris in Petah Tikva while standing beside vehicle. Suffered severe multi-system injuries; transported to Beilinson Hospital. Later condition improved to moderate and stable.

Woman stopped vehicle at roadside upon hearing alert. Home Front Command guidance: if advance warning received while driving, use time to improve position and reach optimal protected space; if no time, stop safely, exit vehicle, move away from road, lie on ground, protect head.

Benny Gantz (Kahol Lavan chair): 'Education system should open and government should spare parents headaches by announcing today that if there is no dramatic change in situation assessment, entire education system will return after holiday. Anyone with a protected space can and should return.'

Opposition leader Yair Lapid: 'Israel is fighting well and being managed poorly. Government has not achieved its war objectives. Strategic decision promised has not been implemented. No progress in central areas: regime change, removing security threats, leading regional initiative.'
Four Nahal Brigade soldiers killed in combat in southern Lebanon: Sergeant Noam Madmoni, Sergeant-Major Ben Cohen, Sergeant-Major Maxim Antis, Sergeant-Major Gilad Harel.

Lena Shagai, resident whose apartment was destroyed in Haifa strike: 'It was like three floors compressed together.' She and husband were in shelter; returned to assist rescue efforts per Home Front Command request.

Iranian ballistic missile broke apart in air over Haifa, causing interception failure. Penetrating body with hundreds of kilograms of explosives struck building causing collapse. Warhead did not detonate; damage from structural collapse, not explosion.
Four bodies recovered from building rubble in Haifa after direct Iranian missile strike: elderly couple, their 40-year-old son, and a foreign national.
Education Ministry: schools continue remote learning Thursday-Friday; partial return to physical classes under discussion for next week, 30-50% student capacity with rotating shifts.
Rabbi Shmuel Eliyahu, chief rabbi of Safed, visited Golani fighters on front lines, conducted prayer service and provided spiritual guidance during combat operations.

National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir at Haifa strike site: 'We must adopt a strategy of victory against Iran' and emphasized importance of adhering to protection guidelines and entering shelters.
Multiple waves of missile fire from Iran; direct hit on residential building in Haifa; rescue forces searching for trapped residents; one elderly woman collapsed while rushing to shelter in Tel Aviv.
Alerts activated repeatedly in Gush Dan, Sharon, Shephelah, Samaria, and Jerusalem without advance warning, causing panic among residents.
Bat Yam mayor Tzvi Brut: '50% of children in Gush Dan lack standard shelter at home, but if they attend kindergarten, 100% will have standard shelter during alerts.'
Bat Yam mayor Tzvi Brut announced kindergartens and some elementary/secondary classes will reopen after Passover, with full shelter protection and emergency protocols in place.
Three injured in central Israel (Petah Tikva, Tel Aviv) from missile strikes; one woman in serious condition; two bodies recovered from Haifa building collapse.
Air defense systems failed to intercept Iranian missile; multiple interceptors missed target; warhead did not detonate but building collapsed from impact force alone.
Maj. (res.) Asaf Dagan, combat navigator, died by suicide in October 2024 after suffering PTSD from intensive reserve service following October 7 events.

Education Ministry and Home Front Command discussing phased return to schools: grades 1-3 and 11-12 prioritized; only in institutions meeting strict shelter standards; 30-50% student capacity with rotating shifts.
Bat Yam mayor Tzvi Brut: 'Our job is to provide an answer to parents so they can live during emergency routine. We will know how to handle every challenge professionally and with patience.'
Bat Yam conducted comprehensive preparations: thorough scans of school grounds and roofs for missile fragments, deep cleaning, trained emergency coordinators placed in institutions.
Four people killed in Haifa building collapse: elderly couple, their 40-year-old son, and a foreign national caregiver; all found outside protected shelter.

Education Minister Yoav Kisch: Thursday-Friday no change in current policy; remote learning continues per Home Front Command color-coded map; decision on next week's model pending security assessment.
Fire and Rescue Service commander Kobi Mizrahi: 'This is the most difficult scene in the district so far, in terms of destruction scale, complexity, and casualties.'
Cluster missile attack on central Israel: 15 impact sites across Petah Tikva, Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, Kiryat Ono, Bnei Brak; woman age 34 hit by shrapnel in serious condition.

MDA paramedic Noam Dehan: 'We saw a vehicle with shattered windows and inside a conscious woman suffering serious injuries from shrapnel. We provided life-saving medical care and evacuated her to hospital in serious condition.'
Rabbis of Bnei Brak issued urgent warning against residents gathering at missile strike sites, citing danger of collapse and interference with rescue operations.

128 educational institutions damaged by missile fire; at least 3 completely out of service (elementary school and daycare in Beersheba, kindergarten in Beit Shemesh); alternative facilities being provided.
Over 1,000 men gathered underground for Haredi rabbi address, violating Home Front Command guideline limiting gatherings to 50 people in central Israel without nearby shelter.
Two bodies recovered from Haifa building rubble after hours of rescue efforts; two additional people still missing.
34-year-old woman hit by shrapnel in Petah Tikva in serious condition; man in his 30s lightly injured by glass shards in Tel Aviv from cluster missile attack.
Haifa resident Vered Ohana: 'It was a huge boom, a crazy boom. It was clear that there was a direct hit.'
Maj. (res.) Asaf Dagan died by suicide in October 2024; suffered PTSD from intensive reserve duty after October 7; officially recognized as IDF casualty.
Health Ministry: 163 injured in past 24 hours from Iran and Hezbollah attacks; 1 serious, 4 moderate, 153 good condition; 5 treated for anxiety.

Knesset Research Center: 14% of Israeli schools have no protection; 24% have partial protection; ~466,000 students (25% of total) lack adequate shelter; Education Ministry missing data on 50% of kindergartens.
Dagan family statement: 'Moral injury in pilots, which leads to development of PTSD, is a service injury for all intents and purposes.' Dagan paid 'heavy psychological price' from service.
Israeli Air Force probe: Iranian missile fragmented midair; interceptors missed due to changed trajectory; warhead did not detonate but building collapsed from impact force.
Third body recovered from Haifa rubble: man in his 40s; fourth body expected to be recovered in coming hours; four people total unaccounted for after missile strike.
Four bodies recovered from rubble at Iranian ballistic missile impact site in Haifa: man and woman in their 80s, man in his 40s, woman aged 35
Two individuals retrieved from rubble without signs of life following Iranian missile strike on Haifa residential building
Dagan family: 'PTSD and mental health injuries are service injuries just like any other' — Maj. (res.) Asaf Dagan committed suicide after suffering post-traumatic stress disorder-related symptoms
Iranian missile attack hits Tel Aviv area: 5 wounded; at least 20 impact sites reported
Air raid sirens activated across central Israel, Jerusalem area, Tel Aviv metropolitan region, Shfela lowlands, Sharon region, Dead Sea area and parts of West Bank following Iranian missile launches
At least 15 impact sites across central Israel; 32-year-old woman seriously wounded in Petah Tikvah, one person moderately wounded, second person sustained light injuries
Agricultural sector operating under heavy regional tension in March 2026; farmers managing avocado and almond orchards during peak bloom while conflict requires constant attention

Patient: 'You look down and see a parking lot... It's truly horrific... The air was suffocating, with almost no circulation. All the wards were crammed into one another.' Hospitals moved patients to fortified underground areas with concerns over crowding, poor ventilation, infection risks

Haifa Mayor Yona Yahav spoke with President Isaac Herzog following Iranian missile strike; Yahav: 'All city services are operating at the scene with full force, in close cooperation with the Home Front Command and the security and rescue forces'
MDA EMT Ido Edelheit: 'We found a woman in her 90s lying near the stairwell, unconscious and suffering from a severe head injury, after she fell and was injured on her way to the shelter'
Sirens sounded early Monday morning in central Israel, Samaria, Jerusalem and Coastal Plain following three waves of Iranian missile launches; elderly woman injured while heading to shelter

Lehava unit (national unit for special rescues) operating at Haifa impact site; enhanced teams from Israel Electric Corporation and heavy cranes deployed; efforts to extinguish fire hotspots and disconnect energy sources

Dagan family: 'post-traumatic stress and moral injury are service-related injuries in every sense' — Maj. (Res.) Assaf Dagan, Air Force weapon systems officer, took his own life after suffering PTSD from two-decade military service
Building contained a shelter; most residents were inside it and emerged unharmed following direct Iranian missile strike

34-year-old woman injured by missile in Petah Tikva; man around 30 lightly injured in Tel Aviv; heavy property damage reported in Ramat Gan, Bnei Brak, Kiryat Ono, and school building severely damaged in Tel Aviv
